title: Race Watch Party Weekly Watch Time Trend
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:watchparty watch_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(watch_minutes) as avg_duration, max(watch_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst watch time for race watch party events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture watch_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average watch time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether race watch party tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
